mentions.name: Disassembly diff tool
mentions.description: A disassembly diff tool that takes two binary images (old and new) and outputs a report summarizing instruction-level differences, including total instruction and byte deltas, per-category instruction changes (spill, cmov, call, branch, memory, ALU, move, bit manipulation), added/removed bytes, and per-function outcomes (better, worse, removed, unchanged).
mentions.source_excerpt:

input <- old_image new_image

output -> report
